title: Improving Access to the VA Home Loan Benefit Act of 2022
official_summary:
Improving Access to the VA Home Loan Benefit Act of 2022

This act requires the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) to update regulations, requirements, and guidance related to appraisals for housing loans guaranteed by the VA.

Specifically, such regulations or requirements must specify when an appraisal is required, how an appraisal is to be conducted, and who is eligible to conduct an appraisal for such loans. The act also requires the VA to submit to Congress recommendations for improving the delivery times for appraisals for VA loans and to take such recommendations into consideration in prescribing its updated regulations or requirements.

The VA must also provide additional guidance for desktop appraisals, which are performed remotely using information gathered by third parties with whom a VA-approved appraiser has entered into an agreement for such appraisal. In updating such guidance, the VA must specifically take into account situations where (1) desktop appraisals provide cost savings for borrowers, and (2) a traditional appraisal requirement could cause time delays and jeopardize the completion of a transaction.

summary.headline: A 2022 federal law directs the VA to update its rules for appraisals on VA-guaranteed home loans, including remote desktop appraisals.
summary.what_it_does: The law requires the Department of Veterans Affairs to update its rules and guidance on home appraisals for loans it guarantees. The updated rules must say when an appraisal is needed, how it must be done, and who may perform it. The VA must also send Congress recommendations for speeding up appraisal times and consider them when writing the new rules. Finally, the VA must issue guidance on desktop appraisals, which are done remotely, and consider cost savings for borrowers and the risk of delays.

who_it_affects.group: Veterans and service members using VA home loan benefits
who_it_affects.how: The rules for when and how their home appraisals are done may change once the VA finishes its updates.

who_it_affects.group: Home buyers and borrowers with VA-guaranteed loans
who_it_affects.how: They could see different appraisal requirements, possibly including lower-cost remote desktop appraisals in some cases.

who_it_affects.group: Licensed appraisers who work on VA loans
who_it_affects.how: The VA will set new rules on who is eligible to perform appraisals for these loans and how the work must be done.

who_it_affects.group: Lenders and third parties that gather information for desktop appraisals
who_it_affects.how: Their role in desktop appraisals will be shaped by the VA's new guidance on those appraisals.
